interpretations.scope_boundary: One read-only GET /v1/users/{userId}/export endpoint that streams the calling user's own four profile fields as a single-row CSV attachment; boundary is self-export of profile-only data — the caller's token subject must equal {userId} or it's rejected, and nothing beyond those four fields is ever emitted.
surfaces_in_scope: The route/controller handler for GET /v1/users/{userId}/export
Authorization check comparing authenticated token subject (userId) against the path {userId}, returning 403 on mismatch
Profile read against existing user store/repository for the single {userId}
CSV serialization of the fixed column set {id, email, displayName, createdAt} including header row and value escaping (commas/quotes/newlines)
HTTP response headers: Content-Type: text/csv and Content-Disposition: attachment (with a filename)
surfaces_out_of_scope: Admin or bulk/multi-user export of any kind
Any non-CSV format (JSON, PDF, Excel, etc.)
Any related records — orders, sessions, or other associations

New auth/token infrastructure — reuse the existing bearer-auth mechanism, only add the self-match check
Pagination, filtering, date ranges, or rate-limiting features
interpretations.core_behavior: When an authenticated caller GETs /v1/users/{userId}/export for their own userId, the endpoint returns 200 with a text/csv attachment containing a header row plus one row of that user's {id, email, displayName, createdAt}; if the token subject does not match {userId}, it returns 403 and emits nothing.

interpretations.scope_boundary: One read-only endpoint, GET /v1/users/{userId}/export, that returns the authenticated caller's OWN profile (4 fields) as a single-row text/csv attachment, synchronously; the boundary is self-export of profile-only data — nothing crosses into admin/bulk, alternate formats, related records, or async jobs.

interpretations.core_behavior: When a caller GETs /v1/users/{userId}/export with a bearer token whose identity equals {userId}, return 200 with their own {id, email, displayName, createdAt} as a CSV-attachment download; reject any cross-user request with 403.

interpretations.scope_boundary: One read-only HTTP endpoint that serializes exactly four of the authenticated caller's OWN profile fields to a CSV download; the boundary is self-export-of-profile-only — anything beyond {id, email, displayName, createdAt} for the token-owning user (other users, other formats, related records, async jobs) is out.

interpretations.core_behavior: On GET /v1/users/{userId}/export, if the bearer token's subject equals {userId}, synchronously return that user's {id, email, displayName, createdAt} as a two-line text/csv attachment; otherwise reject with 403.

interpretations.scope_boundary: In scope: exactly one read-only synchronous endpoint GET /v1/users/{userId}/export that emits the authenticated caller's OWN four profile fields (id, email, displayName, createdAt) as a single-row text/csv body with a Content-Disposition: attachment filename header, gated by a self-only auth check (bearer subject must equal {userId}, else 403). The boundary stops at the user's own profile: no admin/bulk paths, no alternative formats, no related entities, no async/job machinery.

interpretations.core_behavior: When an authenticated caller requests their own user ID, return HTTP 200 with a one-row text/csv attachment containing exactly id, email, displayName, createdAt; if the bearer token's subject does not match {userId}, deny with 403 and emit no profile data.
